decisionQuestion: Does an incomplete scrape of a public pricing post stay non-final instead of looking like a price cut plus a retirement?

before.quote: Developers can now use this model for just $0.0015 per 1K input tokens and $0.002 per 1K output tokens
before.extraction: Same dated before snapshot as the complete public pair. Both input and output rows are present.

after.quote: Input prices for the new model are reduced by 50% to $0.0005 /1K tokens and output prices are reduced by 25% to $0.0015 /1K tokens.
after.extraction: Hostile capture: only the input dollar figure was kept. The output price from the same sentence was dropped. capture.complete is false. Missing output is a coverage hole, not a vendor retirement.

limits: Released 1.4.0 vendor-budget-impact may still report actionable fieldChanges plus removed counts.
The CI wrapper must mark coverage incomplete, keep status partial, and must not update the baseline.
